best_idea: Highlight the default action for the current target on the action bar, and make instant actions fire on the first press while other actions wait for a target.
decision_why: Keep the target-default highlight and the instant-vs-targeted flag for the action bar, because a finisher or default ability on a downed target is a real readability need at 375 wide. Drop the decorative wobble except as a short cue. Donor defects fixed in the sketch: the default id is computed and never read (hud.cpp:215, hud.h:143), the wobble offset is never cleared (hud.cpp:262), both shader thresholds are 0.8 so the normal band is unreachable (hud.cpp:124), and the click is held-state not press-edge (twp.cpp:687).
acceptance: At 375 wide, with a downed enemy as target, the Finish slot is highlighted on the action bar; a server test asserts the highlighted default is derived from the server snapshot of available actions, and a held button fires an instant action once, not every frame.
